description: This file defines a MultiSelector class that converts a single file input element into a multiple file input list, allowing dynamic addition and removal of file inputs in a web form.

classes.name: MultiSelector
classes.description: A class that manages multiple file input elements, enabling users to select multiple files through dynamic input fields.

methods.name: addElement
methods.description: Adds a new file input element to the form, sets up onchange behavior to create additional inputs, and updates the list display.

methods.name: addListRow
methods.description: Creates a new row in the list display with a delete button to remove the associated file input.
